# E0372: a lens indexes a table with a value that has no entry

A lens looks a value up in a table, and some value the source allows has no
entry. Give the table an entry for every value, or a catch-all.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				t: "a" | "b" | "c"
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				u: 1 | 2
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		_T: {a: 1, b: 2}
		input: _
		result: {
			u: _T[input.t]
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			t: "a"
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0372]: u in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 indexes a table by input.t, which may be "c", for which the table has no entry
  --> lineage.cue:23:7
   |
23 |             u: _T[input.t]
   |                ^^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule table-key-missing)
```
